name: Doctrines
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of adhering to true doctrine as taught by God and His appointed leaders. Jesus taught that His doctrine comes from the Father, and those who seek to do God's will will recognize its divine origin. False teachings, described as commandments of men, are warned against, as they lead to vain worship and are likened to plants not planted by God, destined to be uprooted. The early church leaders, including the apostles and elders, gathered to discern and establish guidelines to preserve the purity of doctrine within the community.
